name: Weighted Scoring Brain
note: Scores inputs using weighted importance factors.

name: Bayesian Scoring Brain
note: Balances new evidence against prior expectations.

name: Fuzzy Logic Scoring Brain
note: Handles partial truth instead of only true or false.

name: Bucket Scoring Brain
note: Turns scores into groups like high, medium, low or red, yellow, green.

name: Rule-Based Scoring Brain
note: Scores based on explicit if/then rules.

name: Confidence Scoring Brain
note: Scores how trustworthy or complete an output is.

name: Risk Scoring Brain
note: Scores risk level, severity, priority, and warning status.

name: Delta Scoring Brain
note: Measures change between old and new values.

name: Metric Scoring Brain
note: Creates measurable metric outputs for dashboards and reports.

name: Yes / No Output Brain
note: Standard yes/no decision output.

name: True / False Output Brain
note: Standard true/false decision output.

name: Pass / Fail Output Brain
note: Standard pass/fail verification output.

name: Testing Brain
note: Verifies unit, smoke, contract, schema, integration, runtime, and acceptance behavior.

name: Runtime Verification Brain
note: Verifies the app installs, starts, runs, connects, builds, and passes smoke checks.

name: Module Compatibility Brain
note: Checks whether separate repos/modules can work together through shared contracts.

name: Recommendation Brain
note: Suggests next actions, best matches, alternatives, and recommended modules or app behavior.

name: Analytics Brain
note: Turns tracked activity and module outputs into dashboards, KPIs, insights, and trends.

name: Rules Brain
note: Defines if/then logic, gates, rule sets, and conditional behavior.

name: Decision Brain
note: Turns inputs into decisions with traceable reasoning paths.

name: Workflow Brain
note: Connects steps, states, actions, and module pipelines.

name: Field Builder Brain
note: Creates configurable fields, labels, names, and behaviors.

name: Button Builder Brain
note: Creates configurable buttons, names, actions, and behaviors.

name: Card Builder Brain
note: Creates configurable cards, names, layouts, and display rules.

name: Profile Builder Brain
note: Defines profiles, profile names, profile fields, profile rules, and behavior.

name: Form Builder Brain
note: Creates forms, form fields, submit actions, validation, and form outputs.

name: Label / Naming Brain
note: Lets users name profiles, fields, cards, buttons, sections, and app labels.

name: Data Tracking Brain
note: Tracks selected events, user actions, app behavior, module outputs, and business metrics.

name: Telemetry Brain
note: Collects runtime signals, usage events, device/app status, and operational data.

name: Document Saver Brain
note: Saves generated documents, exports, reports, receipts, records, and user-created files.

name: Storage / Container Brain
note: Stores app data, module outputs, files, records, and local/cloud state.

name: Database Brain
note: Selects and configures database requirements, tables, records, and persistence.

name: API Connector Brain
note: Connects external APIs, internal APIs, auth headers, request mapping, and responses.

name: Data Mapping Brain
note: Maps one data shape into another for module compatibility.

name: Reporting Brain
note: Generates selected report outputs from module results, metrics, audits, and app data.

name: Summary Report Module
note: Creates short executive summaries for selected module results.

name: Audit Report Module
note: Creates audit reports showing what was checked, passed, failed, and why.

name: Metric Report Module
note: Creates metric-based reports with measurable numbers, counts, deltas, and trends.

name: Compliance Report Module
note: Creates compliance-style reports for requirements, checks, evidence, and approvals.

name: User Report Module
note: Creates user-facing reports for profiles, activity, selections, and outcomes.

name: Business Report Module
note: Creates business reports for KPIs, usage, revenue, conversion, and operations.

name: Payment Logic Brain
note: Handles payment requirements, checkout logic, pricing rules, and plan gates.

name: Subscription Brain
note: Handles subscription tiers, renewal logic, trials, plan gates, and status checks.

name: Affiliate / External Affiliate Brain
note: Handles affiliate links, routing, attribution, tracking, and payout logic.

name: Deployment Brain
note: Handles hosting, GitHub, frontend/backend needs, APIs, Expo, app stores, and readiness.

name: Hosting Brain
note: Chooses Railway, Vercel, Render, Firebase, Supabase, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Expo/EAS.

name: GitHub / Repo Brain
note: Defines repo storage, repo naming, separate module repos, and versioning rules.

name: App Store Upload Brain
note: Handles Android, Google Play, Apple App Store, or both upload paths.

name: Build Framework Brain
note: Chooses Expo, React Native, React, Next.js, Node, Python, Firebase, Supabase, or other frameworks.

name: AI Prompt Brain
note: Lets users describe an app so Logically Done can recommend modules and wiring.

name: Self-Healing Brain
note: Detects failures, suggests repairs, and supports automated recovery workflows.

name: Model Learning Brain
note: Learns from usage, feedback, outcomes, and corrected results over time.

name: UI Layout Brain
note: Provides layout styles like SaaS dashboard, control panel, enterprise console, mobile builder, and card board.

name: Theme / Branding Brain
note: Provides limited launch-safe themes like blue black, white navy, eco green, purple dark, and gray minimal.

name: Image / Asset Brain
note: Handles logos, images, icons, cards, assets, and visual app identity.

name: Security Scan Brain
note: Checks security risks, permission gaps, exposed keys, auth rules, and release safety.

name: Auth / Role Brain
note: Handles sign in, roles, user types, owners, admins, teams, and access rules.

name: Permissions Brain
note: Controls who can view, edit, export, approve, configure, or manage modules.

name: Audit Log Brain
note: Records changes, actions, approvals, errors, module runs, and verification evidence.

name: Enterprise Admin Brain
note: Provides admin controls for organizations, projects, users, modules, reports, and settings.
